# Alibaba.com

> > Global B2B marketplace connecting manufacturers and suppliers across China, specializing in LED lighting, textile accessories, and industrial products.

Alibaba.com hosts thousands of Chinese manufacturers and suppliers offering wholesale products for international trade. The platform features company storefronts showcasing product catalogs, manufacturing capabilities, and OEM services across diverse industries including lighting technology, garment accessories, and consumer goods.

## Key Topics

- China manufacturers
- B2B wholesale marketplace
- LED lighting products
- Guangdong suppliers
- Zhongshan industrial zone
- Wall wash lights
- LED floodlights
- Ribbons and bows
- Garment accessories
- OEM manufacturing
- Product catalogs
- Factory direct sourcing
- Fujian suppliers
